page.overview:
Who is Coladara?

Coladara was born in Tear sometime between 925 and.

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the final days of the Aiel War in the series.

At some point prior to, she was made advisor to King Paitar Nachiman of Arafel. They appear to have a close relationship. She is very fond of him.

When the White Tower split, she sided with neither Elaida nor the Rebels.
